sparse_pack_parity.note: Directory record order may differ; headers and each unique path/offset/size/MD5/flags must agree, and every indexed external payload is verified in each artifact. Android launcher _cl_ is outside the project index but remains covered by exact cross-artifact byte parity.

verifier_regression_scope.coverage: Logical reordering is allowed; altered content/hash/size, missing or extra payload, duplicates, unsafe paths, corrupt headers, unsupported flags/offsets and trailing/truncated data fail. Authoring metadata exclusions preserve runtime assets/licenses.

limitations: Static Android artifact checks plus separate Windows nondebug public-policy execution; no phone or emulator execution in this scope.
Compiled script inventory and remap integrity are checked against frozen export inputs; bytecode was not decompiled to prove source equivalence.
No Play Console upload, real billing transaction, purchase restoration from Google Play, or device-specific installation confirmation.

Stock direct APK uses compressed native libraries with extractNativeLibs=true; ZIP page alignment does not apply to those extracted entries. Every ELF PT_LOAD segment is 16KiB compatible; AAB requests PAGE_ALIGNMENT_16K delivery.

Sparse-PCK directory order can differ between exports; its full logical records and every indexed payload size/digest are verified, while every actual game file remains byte-identical between APK and AAB.
